replication.target_description: Experiment 1b; UK and USA participants pooled across country and statement set; primary H1 comparison of perceived truth for concrete versus abstract versions of original 52 items, after participant exclusions and removal of self-reported known items; paired one-sided t-test.

n.location: p. 8, Table 6, Total row, N analysed

n.exclusions: Table 6: 237 recruited, 17 excluded, 220 analysed. Technological aids (9), uniform responses (1), 59 or more known items (1), unusually high accuracy (9, including 3 already excluded for technological aids). Timing rule: less than 3 minutes excluded; maximum 45 minutes. Known items removed within participants.

reported_success.quote: Inconsistent with the original study, concrete items were not rated as significantly truer than abstract items for either the original items or the revised set of items.

notes:

Printed standardized paired effect retained as dz without conversion.
